import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('/workspace/data.xlsx', data_only=True)
ws = wb['Sheet1']

# Get all efficacy values (column C, index 2) to understand response categories
efficacy_vals = set()
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_row=ws.max_row, values_only=True):
    efficacy_vals.add(row[2])

print(f"Efficacy values: {efficacy_vals}")

# Count of each efficacy value
from collections import Counter
efficacy_counts = Counter()
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_row=ws.max_row, values_only=True):
    efficacy_counts[row[2]] += 1
print(f"Efficacy counts: {efficacy_counts}")

# Print last 20 rows
print("\nLast 20 rows:")
for row_idx, row in enumerate(ws.iter_rows(min_row=max(1, ws.max_row-19), max_row=ws.max_row, values_only=True), ws.max_row-19):
    print(f"Row {row_idx}: {list(row[:12])}")

# Check BMI values
bmi_vals = [row[10] for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_row=ws.max_row, values_only=True)]
print(f"\nBMI range: {min(bmi_vals)} - {max(bmi_vals)}")
print(f"BMI type: {type(bmi_vals[0])}")
print(f"Missing BMI count: {sum(1 for b in bmi_vals if b is None)}")

import json

api_key = "[REDACTED_GALAXY_API_KEY]"
gi = bioblend.galaxy.GalaxyInstance(url="https://usegalaxy.org", key=api_key)

hist_id = "bbd44e69cb8906b54b65f49208887b74"

representation = {
    "class": "GalaxyUserTool",
    "id": "logistic-regression-aic-v1",
    "name": "Logistic Regression AIC",
    "version": "0.1.0",
    "container": "quay.io/biocontainers/r-base:4.4.1",
    "shell_command": """set -eu
Rscript - "$(inputs.input.path)" << 'REOF'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
data <- read.table(args[1], header=TRUE, sep="\t", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
data <- data[!is.na(data$BMI) & !is.na(data$Efficacy) & data$Efficacy != "", ]
data$PR <- ifelse(data$Efficacy == "PR", 1, 0)
model <- glm(PR ~ BMI, data = data, family = binomial)
aic_val <- AIC(model)
write.table(data.frame(AIC = aic_val), "aic_result.tsv", sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)
REOF
""",
    "inputs": [
        {
            "name": "input",
            "type": "data",
            "format": ["tabular"]
        }
    ],
    "outputs": [
        {
            "name": "result",
            "type": "data",
            "format": "tabular",
            "from_work_dir": "aic_result.tsv"
        }
    ]
}

print("Creating UDT...")
if hasattr(gi, "unprivileged_tools"):
    created = gi.unprivileged_tools.create_user_tool(representation)
    print(f"Created UDT UUID: {created['uuid']}")

        tool_uuid=created["uuid"],
        tool_inputs=tool_inputs,
    )
    print(f"Submitted: {json.dumps(submitted, indent=2)}")
    for job in submitted.get("jobs", []):
        print(f"Job ID: {job['id']}")
else:
    print("ERROR: BioBlend UDT interface unavailable")

with open("/workspace/data_tabular.tsv", "r") as f:

bmi_idx = header.index("BMI")

bmi_vals = []
pr_vals = []

for line in lines[1:]:
    fields = line.strip().split("\t")
    if len(fields) <= max(efficacy_idx, bmi_idx):
        continue
    efficacy = fields[efficacy_idx].strip()
    bmi_str = fields[bmi_idx].strip()
    
    if not efficacy or not bmi_str:
        continue
    
    try:
        bmi = float(bmi_str)
    except ValueError:
        continue
    
    bmi_vals.append(bmi)
    pr_vals.append(1 if efficacy == "PR" else 0)

print(f"\nTotal valid rows: {len(pr_vals)}")

print(f"BMI range: {min(bmi_vals):.2f} - {max(bmi_vals):.2f}")

print(f"Mean PR: {mean_pr:.4f}")

# The AIC from glm should be correct. Let me not re-derive it manually
# but trust the R glm computation

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
data <- read.table(args[1], header=TRUE, sep="	", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
data <- data[!is.na(data$BMI) & !is.na(data$Efficacy) & data$Efficacy != "", ]
data$PR <- ifelse(data$Efficacy == "PR", 1, 0)
model <- glm(PR ~ BMI, data = data, family = binomial)
aic_val <- AIC(model)
write.table(data.frame(AIC = aic_val), "aic_result.tsv", sep="	", row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)
REOF
